answer: Transactions & Dealings >> Interest & Insurance Question ID: 1954 Country: India Title: I have withdrawal 6000 rs from bank which i received as interest. then again after two days i have withdrawn 10000 rs from my salary. these two bundles of money got mixed . i dont want to use interest money but dont know how to segregate this from mixed bundle. Question: I have withdrawal 6000 rs from bank which i received as interest. then again after two days i have withdrawn 10000 rs from my salary. these two bundles of money got mixed . i dont want to use interest money but dont know how to segregate this from mixed bundle. Answer ID: 1954 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 722/718=N) In the above mentioned case the loan you have taken is not interest, you can use them in your needs. Interest will be the additional amount that you will pay while repaying this loan. But, it is to be noted that taking interest based loan from bank and so is not allowed, since Allah says: وَأَحَلَّ اللَّهُ الْبَيْعَ وَحَرَّمَ الرِّبَا But Allah has permitted trade and forbidden usury. (2/275) Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
